name: CategoryTheory.induct_on_objects
script:
intro J inst hc p j₀ h0 h1 j
have key := CategoryTheory.constant_of_preserves_morphisms
    (fun k : J => (⟨k ∈ p⟩ : ULift.{0, 0} Prop))
    (fun j₁ j₂ f => congrArg ULift.up (propext (h1 f))) j j₀
have h : (j ∈ p) = (j₀ ∈ p) := congrArg ULift.down key
rw [h]
exact h0

name: IntermediateField.normal_iff_forall_map_eq
script:
intro F L iF iL iA iN K
rw [IntermediateField.normal_iff_forall_map_le]
constructor
· intro h σ
  refine le_antisymm (h σ) ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : L ≃ₐ[F] L, ∀ y, e y = σ y :=
    ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective σ (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.algHom_bijective σ), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have h1 : e.symm x ∈ K :=
    h (e.symm : L →ₐ[F] L) (IntermediateField.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, by simp⟩)
  refine IntermediateField.mem_map.mpr ⟨e.symm x, h1, ?_⟩
  rw [← he]
  exact e.apply_symm_apply x
· intro h σ
  exact (h σ).le

name: WithCStarModule.norm_equiv_le_norm_prod
script:
intro A _ _ E F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ x
have h1 : ‖(WithCStarModule.equiv A (E × F) x).1‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  first
  | exact WithCStarModule.norm_fst_le x
  | exact WithCStarModule.fst_norm_le x
  | exact CStarModule.norm_fst_le x
  | exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (WithCStarModule.max_le_norm x)
  | exact le_trans le_sup_left (WithCStarModule.max_le_norm x)
  | exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (WithCStarModule.max_norm_le_norm x)
have h2 : ‖(WithCStarModule.equiv A (E × F) x).2‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  first
  | exact WithCStarModule.norm_snd_le x
  | exact WithCStarModule.snd_norm_le x
  | exact CStarModule.norm_snd_le x
  | exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (WithCStarModule.max_le_norm x)
  | exact le_trans le_sup_right (WithCStarModule.max_le_norm x)
  | exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (WithCStarModule.max_norm_le_norm x)
first
| (rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact max_le h1 h2)
| exact max_le h1 h2
| (rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact sup_le h1 h2)
| exact sup_le h1 h2
| (simp only [Prod.norm_def]; exact max_le h1 h2)

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis
script:
intro 𝕜 _ n _ A _ hA j
have h := hA.apply_eigenvectorBasis j
have key : A.mulVec (hA.eigenvectorBasis j).ofLp
    = WithLp.ofLp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp
have key2 : WithLp.ofLp ((hA.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) • (hA.eigenvectorBasis j))
    = (hA.eigenvalues j : 𝕜) • WithLp.ofLp (hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp
rw [key, h, key2]
first
| exact (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul _ _).symm
| (funext i; simp [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul])
| simp [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul]
